creation.title: Creation
creation.summary: The world is spoken into being — light, order, and a human made in the divine image.

noah.title: Noah & the Covenant
noah.summary: After the flood, a covenant with all humanity and every living creature — sealed by the rainbow.

babel.title: Babel & the Seventy Languages
babel.summary: One language, one tower — and the dispersion of humanity into many tongues.

abraham.title: Abraham
abraham.summary: “Go forth” — a journey that begins with leaving everything familiar behind.

akedah.title: The Binding of Isaac
akedah.summary: The most debated test in literature: faith, obedience and a life spared.

exodus.title: The Exodus
exodus.summary: A people walks out of slavery and through the sea.

song-of-the-sea.title: Song of the Sea
song-of-the-sea.summary: The first great song of freedom, sung on the far shore.

sinai.title: Sinai
sinai.summary: A mountain wrapped in smoke, and a people preparing to listen.

ten-commandments.title: The Ten Commandments
ten-commandments.summary: Ten statements that became a foundation of moral law.

holiness.title: Holiness
holiness.summary: Holiness in everyday life — culminating in “love your neighbor as yourself.”

priestly-blessing.title: Priestly Blessing
priestly-blessing.summary: Three short lines of blessing, spoken for three thousand years.

shema.title: Shema
shema.summary: “Hear, O Israel” — the declaration of oneness at the heart of Jewish life.

choose-life.title: Choose Life
choose-life.summary: “It is not in heaven” — the choice between life and death is placed in human hands.

haazinu.title: Ha'azinu
haazinu.summary: Moses' final song, calling heaven and earth as witnesses.
